method.item_marks: Printed item marks; where one printed mark covers several unmarked sub-parts, the capture's equal split (marks_est).
method.choice_rule_weighting: Each question's marks are multiplied by w = (questions to answer)/(questions offered) in its section (w = 1 for compulsory questions; 2023: Q1 compulsory, w = 4/6 for Q2-Q7), then scaled so each paper sums exactly to its stated total. This is the expected value of each item to a candidate who chooses optional questions uniformly.
method.lesson_attribution: Prerequisite tags removed; 50% to the primary (first) lesson, 50% split equally over supporting lessons (100% when one lesson). Variants 'equal' and 'primary_only' in sensitivity.
method.concept_attribution: Captured concept ids mapped to canonical concepts (canonical_concepts); same 50/50 primary rule.
method.aggregation: Share = effective marks / all effective marks of the group, in percent. Each paper weighs by its total (s3 = 200 = p1 + p2).
method.unit_of_item: Formats, skills and difficulty per unit use the unit of the item's primary lesson.
method.frequency: papers = number of the 20 papers containing at least one item tagged with it; papers_in_scope_present = the same count restricted to papers whose scope includes its unit; coverage = papers_in_scope_present / papers_in_scope. concepts_by_coverage lists concepts tested in all four years (highlights.always_tested_full_coverage = coverage 1.0 only).
method.scope_rule: Supporting lesson and concept tags from units outside a paper's scope (e.g. unit 1 inside paper 2) are treated as prerequisites and not counted; they stay on the item as out_of_scope_tags.
method.question_marks: paper_structures question_marks = sum of the question's item marks (reconciled); a printed heading that differs is kept in question_marks_printed with the capture's note.
method.trend: Least-squares slope of yearly share (pp/yr). 'rising'/'falling' needs |slope| >= 1 and a >= 1.5 pp change between the 2022-23 and 2024-25 means. Four data points: treat as signals.
method.patterns: Each item gets one recurring template of its primary lesson by ordered rules on paraphrase, formula, format and concepts.
